about: Recurring open mics with music slots in the western Inland Empire. Community list; times change, so check the source link before you go.

properties.name: Riverside Open Mic Music Series (Wednesday Musicians' Open Mic)
properties.schedule_text: Every Wednesday; sign-up 5:30 PM, open mic 6 PM to 9 PM (per host listing for 2026-12-02)
properties.host: Patrick Maloney / Riverside Open Mic Music Series
properties.notes: Host's Instagram flyers (checked 2026-11-07): "Sign Up 530pm - Open Mic 6pm to 9pm - Music Only". The 6:30/7:00 times seen elsewhere belong to the Thursday comedy mic.

properties.name: Open Mic Night at the Downtown Art Gallery
properties.venue: Chino Hills Community Foundation Downtown Art Gallery, The Shoppes at Chino Hills
properties.address: The Shops at Chino Hills, Suite 4020 (between Bed Bath & Beyond and Seven Leaves Cafe), Chino Hills, CA 91709
properties.schedule_text: Roughly monthly, usually Friday evenings; dated listings Fri Feb 20, a mid-March date, and Fri Jun 19 2026 (a search snippet said Thu Jun 18)
properties.signup_method: In person, sign-ups start at 6 pm
properties.instagram: https://www.instagram.com/p/DTN1vS3FBAE/ (lead, post only; account not identified)
properties.notes: Run by the Chino Hills Community Foundation gallery: music, poetry, comedy, magic; family friendly. Posts seen for Jan 16 and Jun 19, 2026; nothing newer found on the Shops' Instagram (checked 2026-11-07). Confirm before going.

properties.name: Open Mic Night
properties.backline: PA and sound person provided; bring your own instrument
properties.notes: Year not printed on cards. Cards for Sep 27, Jul 26, Jun 28 are absent from the events page, so some months may be skipped or unlisted. No Nov 29 card yet. Older listings said $2. Ages not stated.

properties.name: Deep Cuts: Open Mic and Artist Spotlight
properties.schedule_text: Friday 2026-11-20, 6 PM to 9 PM (Friendsgiving edition); recurrence not stated
properties.signup_method: RSVP via Eventbrite requested for head-count (free); open-mic sign-up method not stated
properties.notes: Evidence is a single upcoming listing (undated page; accessed date used). Title pairs an open mic with a featured artist, so open slots may be limited. A search snippet showed an earlier 'Deep Cuts' edition at the same shop (a Jul 31 date, year unclear) so it recurs, but frequency is unverified. Organizer says 'one music event at a time'. Verify slot availability with the shop.

properties.name: Karaoke and Open Mic at Packinghouse
properties.schedule_text: Some Saturdays, 6-9 pm or later (recent: Sep 5, Sep 19, Nov 21, 2026)
properties.host: Patrick Maloney / Riverside Open Mic Music Series
properties.notes: Karaoke and open mic on the same night, so live-instrument slots may be fewer. Dates from the host's Instagram (checked 2026-11-07) and a Facebook event for Nov 21.

properties.name: Open Mic Night at Rockstars of Tomorrow
properties.schedule_text: Monthly Friday nights; the most recent was Fri Oct 30 at 7 pm. Check the page for the next date.
properties.signup_method: Online form; first come, first served; backing tracks by email
properties.notes: The page shows "SIGN UPS CLOSED!!!" for Oct 30 and gives no next date yet. The year isn't printed; Oct 30 is a Friday in 2026.

properties.name: Open Mic Night at Rockstars of Tomorrow
properties.schedule_text: First Friday of every month, 7-9 pm
properties.signup_method: Online form; first come, first served
properties.backline: Backing tracks by link on the form
